_comment: Reference only — stage0.sh GENERATES the real creds file at runtime via jq from the interactive prompts; do not ship real secrets here. Schema confirmed against archinstall v4.3. encryption_password is plaintext at the top level. Each user takes a plaintext password under '!password' (archinstall also accepts a pre-hashed 'enc_password'). root_enc_password is omitted to leave root locked (the user has sudo).
